results.title: Alaska Election Updates: Peltola Leads Senate Race, Kreiss-Tomkins Near Governor Win
results.description: Democrat Mary Peltola extends her lead over Republican Sen. Dan Sullivan in the U.S. Senate race, now at 49% to 47.2%. Democrat Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins holds 49.9% in the gubernatorial race and could win outright if he passes 50%. Incumbent Republican Nick Begich leads the U.S. House race against independent Bill Hill. Ballot Measure 2 to repeal ranked choice voting trails with 47% yes to 53% no. About 84% of votes have been counted, with more results expected Friday.

results.title: Tripura civic polls: BJP wins 77 seats unopposed, 268 seats go to polls on Nov 27
results.description: BJP has fielded 342 candidates, ahead of CPI(M) with 218 and Congress with 201 nominees statewide.
